title: 雷、予約しました。 ～THUNDER BOOKING～
coreMechanic: Tap/click reserves a lightning strike at that point 900ms later (radius 68). 3 slots: READY→PENDING 900ms→COOLDOWN 1200ms; 120ms global gap. 8 fixed six-drone formations × 5.5s, then boss HP3 with 800ms post-hit shield until 54s.

inputs.reserve: pointerdown on the battlefield (clamped, no snap); 1 tap = 1 slot
inputs.keyboard: arrows move cursor 300px/s, Space (non-repeat) reserves; Space also starts the clock from the READY screen
inputs.pause: button / Esc / P; blur, visibilitychange hidden and pointercancel auto-pause; explicit 再開

practice: Formation 1 three times (16.5s), separate score, no shield loss, no BEST
scoring: Per strike n kills: 100n+50n(n-1) (6 → 2100). Boss kill 2000; clear bonus shield×300 + floor(remaining s)×100. Each once. Formation <3 kills → shield −1 once. Validation max observed by plan: 20400.
rank: S: clear + ≥3 six-kills + 0 formation fails; A: clear + ≥1 six-kill; B: other clear; C: fail
save: web-mini-arcade:v1:ct3:thunder_booking:best:rules1 (JSON best record), web-mini-arcade:v1:ct3:thunder_booking:settings (mute / reduced motion); denied/corrupt storage → in-memory with on-screen note; never enumerates other keys
telemetry: none in staging (no analytics/records calls); Codex to connect existing services in native adapter
art: Procedural code-drawn sprites only (BLOCKED_ART: ImageGen not available/approved in the production session). Not final art.
audio: WebAudio synthesized SE (no samples), voice cap 10, compressor/limiter, mute; not listened to by a human
humanReview: author / physical device / audio-feel / Windows launcher review pending
